request.initial_prompt: But Luzhin was already leaving without finishing his speech, squeezing between the table and the chair; Razumihin got up this time to let him pass. Without glancing at anyone, and not even nodding to Zossimov, who had for some time been making signs to him to let the sick man alone, he went out, lifting his hat to the level of his shoulders to avoid crushing it as he stooped to go out of the door. And even the curve of his spine was expressive of the horrible insult he had received.

raw_segments.text: But Luzhin was already leaving without finishing his speech, squeezing between the table and
the chair. Razumihin got up this time to let him pass. Without glancing at anyone, and not
even nodding to Zossimov, who had for some time been making signs to him to let the sick
man alone, he went out, lifting his hat to the level of his shoulders to avoid crushing
it as he stooped to go out of the door. And even the curve of his spine was expressive
of the horrible insult he had received.
